purpose: Teach: 給油/特許庁/細分/折り返し/見込ん/配合/多角/個展

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、給油代、本気で、節約したぞ、覚えてる、お父さんの代の苦労、お前にも、伝えたい、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: When we started out, I remember how seriously we had to cut corners on fuel costs. The struggles your father went through—I want you to understand that weight. Truly.
lines.style: Patient, measured opening. Draws from deep memory. Slow cadence, letting each phrase settle. Slight weight on the final affirmation—not pushing, but making sure he's hearing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、特許庁、本気で、関係、築いてきましたよね、絶対、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've built a real relationship with the Patent Office. I hold that connection with genuine gratitude and deep respect.
lines.style: Respectful, almost formal. Steady delivery with quiet conviction. Pause before each commitment marker. Voice carries the weight of inherited duty, not burden.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、業務、本気で、細分化、苦労したぞ、ばあさんの代から、絶対、お前にも、頑張って欲しい、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: In those early days, we struggled hard to break down the work into manageable pieces. Since your grandmother's time, that's been the foundation. I want you to carry that forward with real effort.
lines.style: Firm but not stern. Clear-eyed recollection of past difficulty. Slight lean forward on the final request—not commanding, but passing the torch with quiet expectation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への折り返し、お父さんの教え、本気で、絶対、守ってまいります、絶対、感謝、しております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The callbacks to our key clients, the lessons Dad taught me—I will honor those with absolute faithfulness. I carry his trust forward every single day.
lines.style: Steady, almost ceremonial. Each phrase deliberate. Voice rings with sincere commitment, not recitation. The words are a promise he's made to himself first.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前を、本気で、見込んで、社長を、任せたぞ、絶対、お父さんからの、本気の信頼、覚えておけ、本当に、本気。
lines.en: I saw real potential in you, and that's why I entrusted you with the company. Don't forget—that was your father's deepest confidence in you. Hold that close.
lines.style: Warm but weighty. Slight tremor of emotion held in check. Eyes are direct. The final sentence is tender and clear—a gift wrapped in gravity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業時の配合レシピ、本気で、絶対、引き継いでまいります、お父さんの遺志、本気で、本当に、絶対です。
lines.en: Yes. The original blend recipe from our founding days—I will carry that forward faithfully. That was your father's legacy, and I will honor it completely.
lines.style: Reverent, almost ceremonial. Each element pronounced with care. Voice slows on 'legacy'—this is sacred ground. Closes with quiet, unshakeable resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業から、多角化、私たち、本気で、進めてきたな、覚えてる、お父さん、当時の挑戦、思い出すよ、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Since we started, we've pushed into new markets together, I remember. Those early days with your father, the risks we took—I can still see them so clearly.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant gaze inward. Warm nostalgia layered with respect for the risk taken. Pace slows at memories. Closing phrase carries both pride and tenderness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業者として、お父さんの個展、本気で、社内、開催したいです、絶対、お父さんの作品、社員にも、見せたい。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to hold a solo exhibition of my father's work here in the company. I want our staff to see what he created, to understand the artist behind the founder.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tender. A small shift—moving from duty to something more intimate. Quiet reverence for the father and his work. Closes gently, like opening a door.
